description_expanded:
NatureWalk in Seagrove, 30A’s new “it” community

Trail leads directly to San Juan Public Beach Access!

Point Washington State Forest has miles of walking & biking trails

2 community pools!

Gas grill

Smart TVs in every bedroom

3 bikes!

4-star restaurants

Fun eateries and boutiques

Flatwoods 134 by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Flatwoods 134 in NatureWalk at Seagrove Beach is a perfect beach escape. This prime community near 30A offers two pools, hammocks, and the scenic Lilly Lane beach trail, which leads directly to the beach! So quick and easy, especially on a bike. Surrounded by the Point Washington State Forest, it's ideal for outdoor lovers. Evenings at The Gathering Place feature a fire pit, hot tub and lagoon style pool—everything you need for a relaxing stay. Inside this professionally decorated home, the open layout welcomes you with style and comfort. The kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances and a large island with a rounded breakfast bar that seats four, perfect for casual meals.

The living area invites you to unwind on the spacious sectional and enjoy movie nights on the 65" Smart TV. Upstairs, the primary bedroom features a king bed and a roomy bathroom with double sinks and a walk-in shower. There’s also a guest room with a queen bed and a fun bunk room with full-size bunks—great for kids or friends. Flatwoods 134 is surrounded by the natural beauty of the Point Washington State Forest, with miles of scenic walking and biking trails. Plus, it’s just 2.5 miles from Seaside, where you can enjoy a variety of dining and shopping options. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 3 bedrooms; 2.5 bath - 1891 sq ft - Smart TVs in every bedroom - Limited onsite parking for two vehicles/no garage access (No on-street parking allowed) - Gas grill - 2 community pools - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included Overnight: - King bed in 2nd floor primary bedroom; bath, Smart TV (55”) - Queen bed in 2nd floor guest room; Smart TV (43”) - Full bunk beds in 2nd floor guest room; Smart TV - Full sleeper sofa in living room sectional Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
